preconditions.description: Number of nodes n, edges m, and lower limit k satisfy the given constraints.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n and a_i != b_i for a_i, b_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct nodes within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: all(len(list(filter(lambda x: x[0] == i or x[1] == i, edges))) >= k for i in range(1, n + 1))
preconditions.description: Each node has at least k neighbors.

postconditions.description: The length of the cycle is at least k + 1 and at most n.

postconditions.expression: len(set(v_i for v_i in cycle)) == r
postconditions.description: All nodes in the cycle are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all((cycle[i], cycle[(i + 1) % r]) in edges or (cycle[(i + 1) % r], cycle[i]) in edges for i in range(r))
postconditions.description: Each consecutive pair of nodes in the cycle is connected by an edge.

postconditions.expression: (cycle[0], cycle[r - 1]) in edges or (cycle[r - 1], cycle[0]) in edges
postconditions.description: The first and last nodes in the cycle are connected by an edge.
